Name: Increased Cooking Prices
Author: GrumpyEkhor
Description:
This mod attempts to re-balance the price of cooked dishes so that you don't lose the value of your ingredients. Higher level dishes add additional value to compensate against the opportunity cost of processing ingredients into artisan goods. Hopefully this enables a new play style for you prospective Stardew chefs!

Feel free to check out the documentation tab to see the full list of price adjustments, and Happy Farming!

Manifest.Name: Increased Cooking Prices
Manifest.Description: Raises the prices of most cooked dishes.
